content:
tvOS 27 is the latest software update for Apple TV 4K, rolling out to all users starting today. Here are the new features in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 introduces an all-new Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customizable text sizes, and more.

tvOS 27 can be installed from the Settings app on Apple TV. This update is available for all Apple TV 4K models (except the first generation); Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple's tvOS 27 update includes the following features and changes:

Podcasts: Apple Podcasts gets a major revamp on tvOS, following the design direction of the earlier iOS update this year. The new tvOS version of the Podcasts app fully supports Apple's video features, making it easy for users to watch video podcasts. The interface also features a fresh design with sidebar navigation for a smoother experience.

Update via iPhone: tvOS 27 brings a convenient new feature that lets users update Apple TV 4K software directly from their iPhone. Through the Home app on iOS 27, you can install tvOS 27 and future system updates without even turning on your Apple TV.

Apple Music Upgrade: tvOS 27 brings two new features to Apple Music. AutoMix arrives on Apple TV, delivering DJ-style transitions between songs—perfect for parties. Hi-Res Lossless Audio has also been added, though compatible external speakers are required for output.

Larger Text Size: Users can now adjust the system-wide text size through the Dynamic Type feature in the Settings app, making it easier to read from the couch in different viewing environments.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connectivity, smoother animations, quicker app launch times, and a more responsive Control Center.

Missing Features: Siri AI and Smart Downloads

Notably, tvOS 27 does not include the new Siri AI assistant and only offers the older version of Siri. Reports suggest this is because the upcoming new Apple TV 4K will feature more powerful hardware capable of supporting Siri AI.

Another missing feature is the "Smart Downloads" function Apple mentioned at WWDC. Since tvOS has never supported content downloads for TV, the announcement at the time came as a surprise. "Smart Downloads" may refer to certain system-related functions rather than TV shows or movies. In any case, this feature is still nowhere to be seen in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How does it feel to use? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
